channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Seis em cada dez brasileiros veem declarações de Michelle sobre Flávio como verdadeiras, indica Meio/Ideia
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows 64% of Brazilians believe Michelle Bolsonaro’s statements about her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro are true, with 29% saying completely true and 35% more true than false. The video in which she accused Flávio of disrespecting her has caused a rift in Bolsonaro’s camp, undermining public trust in her and hindering Flávio’s effort to attract female voters, who currently favor Lula by a wide margin.

item.title: As intenções de voto de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro no Maranhão, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro by 38 points in Maranhão, with 60% of voting intentions in the first round, according to a Real Time Big Data poll. The president would win a potential runoff by 33 points (62% to 29%). The margin of error is 2 percentage points at a 95% confidence level.

item.title: PF realiza operação na casa de Bolsonaro em busca de armas
item.description: The Federal Police conducted an operation at the residence of Jair Bolsonaro in Brasília, following an order from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, to search for undeclared weapons. The action follows contradictory statements made by Bolsonaro's defense regarding his armament since last week.

item.title: Bolsonaro é alvo de operação da PF para verificar se há armas e munições em casa
item.description: Federal Police executed a search warrant at former President Jair Bolsonaro's residence seeking firearms and ammunition, but found nothing. His defense claims all ten registered weapons have been disclosed to authorities, including a shotgun in Rio Grande do Sul, and called the operation unjustified.

item.title: Os dois pontos de tensão nas audiências sobre tarifaço dos EUA
item.description: During the USTR hearings on the U.S. tariffs on Brazil, two moments created tension: on Monday, U.S. rural producers defended maintaining tariffs on Brazilian beef, linking it to deforestation, forced labor, and corruption using outdated 2022 data; on Tuesday, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s political speech caused discomfort among U.S. representatives, contrasting with the otherwise technical tone of the proceedings.

item.title: A mulher mais poderosa do Brasil
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady and wife of Jair Bolsonaro, was identified by 15.4% of voters as 'the woman with the most power in Brazil today,' according to a Meio/Ideia poll. This perception persists despite her husband being under house arrest for attempted coup, and her frequent public displays of loyalty and care toward him.

item.title: Flamengo x Laussane-Sport: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Flamengo faces Lausanne-Sport on Wednesday, July 8, at 4:30 PM Brasília time, at the Estádio do Algarve in Portugal, in the Algarve Trophy, as part of their preparation for the 2026 World Cup. Coach Leonardo Jardim is expected to field a reserve side to rest starters for the upcoming friendly against Benfica on Saturday, as several players are unavailable due to injury or World Cup duty. The match will be broadcast on Band, Sportv, ge tv, and Premiere.

item.title: PGR pede que STF valide decretos que elevaram IOF
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (PGR) defended before the STF the constitutionality of decrees by President Lula's government that increased IOF rates, stating the Executive has constitutional authority to act in tax matters with an extrafiscal character, especially in response to changes in credit, exchange, and insurance markets. The PGR rejected the claim that increased revenue constitutes a diversion of purpose, affirming that 'risco sacado' retains its credit nature even when structured as assignment of credit rights.

item.title: Selma Leite é nomeada desembargadora do TJDFT
item.description: Selma Leite was appointed as a judge of the TJDFT by President Lula, following the court's triple list, filling the vacancy left by the death of Judge Maurício Silva Miranda in January 2026. She has served as a prosecutor for 19 years, specializing in child and youth justice, and currently holds the position of vice-prosecutor-general of the MPDFT.

item.title: A avaliação dos eleitores sobre o vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo pesquisa
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll shows that 57.6% of voters were aware of Michelle Bolsonaro's video against Flávio Bolsonaro, and among them, 64% found her statements at least more true than false. Despite this, her confidence increased only to 23.4%, while 44.4% reported no change and 17.3% said it decreased. In a hypothetical runoff against Lula, Michelle trails by nine points (36% vs 45%), worsening from a six-point deficit in May.

item.title: Flávio tem 45%, e Lula, 42%, em eventual 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 45% voting intention against 42% for Lula in a potential 2026 runoff, according to a Gerp poll released on July 8. The candidates are technically tied within the 2.2 percentage point margin of error. The survey interviewed 2,000 people between July 3 and 7, 2026, with a 95% confidence level and TSE registration BR-03067/2026.

item.title: Efeito Trump: cai o comércio com EUA e China avança no Brasil
item.description: Brazilian exports to the U.S. fell 13.0% in the first half of 2026, while exports to China rose 21.9%, signaling a commercial shift toward Beijing. This comes amid threats of new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods — potentially up to 37.5% starting in August — despite similar measures being partially overturned in court in 2025. Strengthening trade ties with China are diminishing U.S. influence in Brazil, creating a politically and economically unstable environment that could affect the 2026 elections.

item.title: Flávio só piora: fez teatro nos EUA e colheu repúdio por traição
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a U.S. hearing to seek delay or cancellation of 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, but was criticized for using the event as an electoral platform and for previously supporting a 50% tariff hike. The Lula government condemned his actions as 'treason against the homeland', noting he was the only Brazilian among 34 participants not to oppose the measures, instead advocating delay for electoral gain. Analysts say the Bolsonaro clan is acting out of electoral desperation, trying to avoid being linked to Trump’s protectionism during the campaign.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 49% e Flávio, por 40%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula is the most rejected politician in the country, with 49% of respondents stating they would not vote for him 'under any circumstances,' followed by Flávio Bolsonaro at 40%. The Gerp survey, conducted between July 3 and 7, 2026, with 2,000 respondents, has a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. Michelle Bolsonaro and Fernando Haddad rank third and fourth, with 18% and 16% rejection, respectively.

item.title: Lula é aprovado por 41% e desaprovado por 50%, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Gerp poll released on July 8, 2026, shows 50% of respondents disapprove of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s (PT) government, while 41% approve, with a 2.2 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. Government evaluation reveals 35% rate it as 'excellent' or 'good', 17% as 'fair', and 45% as 'poor' or 'very poor'. The survey, registered with the TSE under BR-03067/2026, interviewed 2,000 people from July 3–7 and was funded by the São Paulo State Radio and Television Broadcasters Association.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro: dois embusteiros em busca de atenção
item.description: The author criticizes the 2022 Brazilian presidential election as being marked by extreme mediocrity, comparing it to the 2018 race and suggesting even the Haddad vs. Bolsonaro contest lacked real substance. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are portrayed as attention-seekers spreading falsehoods, reflecting a deteriorated political landscape.

item.title: Lula e Flávio estão tecnicamente empatados no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Meio/Ideia poll released on July 8, 2026, shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) leading with 40.4% in the first round, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) at 32%. In a hypothetical second-round scenario, Lula and Flávio are technically tied at 45% and 40%, respectively, within the 2.5-point margin of error. Lula also has the highest rejection rate at 46.4%, compared to Flávio’s 43.4%.

item.title: Governo Lula é desaprovado por 48,5% e aprovado por 46,5%
item.description: A Meio/Ideia poll conducted from July 3–6, 2026, with 1,500 respondents nationwide, shows President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government has a 48.5% disapproval rate and 46.5% approval, with a 2.5 percentage point margin of error and 95% confidence level. 41% rated the administration as 'bad/terrible', 32.5% as 'good/excellent', and 24.5% as 'fair'. The survey, registered with the TSE under BR-05628/2026, cost R$27,600 and was funded by Canal Meio.

item.title: Lula mantém vantagem sobre Flávio Bolsonaro no 2º turno, aponta Meio Ideia
item.description: Lula (PT) maintains a lead over Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) in a simulated runoff for the 2026 elections, according to a Meio Ideia poll released on January 8, 2026. The advantage shows the incumbent president ahead in a potential matchup against the Bolsonaro-aligned senator. The poll reflects electoral stability in the contest between Brazil’s two dominant political forces.

item.title: Pesquisa Meio/Ideia: Lula tem 45% e Flávio Bolsonaro, 40% no segundo turno
item.description: Lula has 45% and Flávio Bolsonaro 40% in a hypothetical runoff, technically tied within the margin of error. Lula leads among women (50.4%) and Northeastern voters (62.7%), while Flávio leads among men (46.3%) and evangelicals (61.1%). The poll shows Lula would defeat all other tested candidates in a runoff scenario.

item.title: Meio/Ideia: Lula é aprovado por 46,5% e desaprovado por 48,5%
item.description: The Meio/Ideia poll released on June 8 shows President Lula's approval at 46.5% and disapproval at 48.5%, with changes within the margin of error. Despite a slight decline in disapproval, his approval level is seen as fragile for re-election due to a low popularity ceiling among Bolsonaro voters from 2022. Approval is highest in the Northeast and among lower-income classes, while disapproval is strongest among evangelicals and Southern residents.

item.title: Após vazamento, diretor do INSS anuncia fim de grupo de campanha para Lula
item.description: The director of Benefits and Relations at INSS, Leonardo Bittencourt, announced the termination of the WhatsApp group 'INSS with Lula', created by public employees to support Lula’s campaign, after its exposure by the press. He stated the group used only private phones, had no institutional ties, and that no retaliation would occur against non-participants. The group had been used to organize a pro-Lula event and distribute campaign shirts, despite electoral law prohibiting public campaigning before August 16.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que 90% não sabem da sua pré-candidatura à Presidência
item.description: Augusto Cury, a presidential pre-candidate from the Avante party, acknowledges that 90% of the population is unaware of his pre-candidacy, hindering campaign viability. He notes that the polarized landscape between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) makes gaining visibility and electoral support even more difficult.

item.title: Rejeição de Flávio acende alerta em campanha de Tarcísio, que fala em ‘limite’ para apoio
item.description: The high rejection of Flávio Bolsonaro and ongoing crises involving his campaign have raised concerns in Tarcísio de Freitas’ team, which is maintaining active distance from supporting the senator to avoid risks to his own re-election in São Paulo. Despite the nominal alliance, Tarcísio prioritizes his own governance legacy and proposals, rejecting any association that could transfer Flávio’s rejection to his image. The PT, led by Fernando Haddad, seeks to exploit this linkage to attach Bolsonaro’s rejection to the governor, while polls show 47% of São Paulo voters prefer an independent governor, and the election may be decided in the first round between Tarcísio and Haddad.

item.title: Maior colégio eleitoral do país, SP atrai convenções partidárias de principais pré-candidatos à presidência
item.description: Four of the five main presidential pre-candidates for 2026 will officially launch their candidacies in conventions held in São Paulo between July 25 and August 5. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will be launched on July 25 at Arena Pacaembu, followed by Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) on July 26 at the party headquarters. Renan Santos (Missão) will unveil his candidacy at the party’s first congress in Mooca, while Lula (PT) is also expected to finalize his ticket in São Paulo, although the text does not provide full details about his event.

item.title: Podcast discute como e por que Flávio Bolsonaro traz tarifaço de Trump para a eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) traveled to the United States to participate in a hearing by the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) regarding the threat of new American tariffs against Brazil. His appearance aims to mitigate damages to his 2026 presidential pre-campaign, leveraging trade policy as a strategic talking point.

item.title: Tarifaço: governo Lula mandou dois diplomatas para audiência nos EUA
item.description: The Lula government sent two diplomats from the Brazilian embassy in Washington to observe the USTR hearing on a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian imports. The diplomats, economic minister-counselor Kassius Pontes and a junior secretary, took notes for Brasília without speaking. The hearing gained attention due to the participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who spoke against the tariff, while the government chose to negotiate through the bilateral working group established during the Lula-Trump meeting at the White House in May 2026.

item.title: Audiência sobre tarifaço: tom técnico gera otimismo a participantes
item.description: Brazilian business associations and company representatives expressed optimism following the USTR hearing on the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, citing the technical nature of the discussions and focus on mutual economic impacts. They believed they successfully conveyed that the measure would harm not only Brazil but also U.S. businesses and consumers, in contrast to the more politicized 2025 hearing.

item.title: Bancadas na Câmara travam votação de projeto que criminaliza misoginia
item.description: The bill criminalizing misoginia is facing resistance in the Chamber of Deputies, particularly from evangelical and Catholic caucuses and parties like PL and Novo, which argue for more debate and fear restrictions on religious freedom and expression. Despite this, the government base, led by the PT and supported by rapporteur Tabata Amaral (PSB-SP), is pushing to pass the bill before the parliamentary recess on July 18, with Chamber President Hugo Motta maintaining a working group to seek consensus.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro implora a Trump: tarifaço, agora não
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro appealed to Trump in Washington to block a new tariff on Brazilian exports, arguing that imposing it now would harm his 2026 presidential campaign by benefiting Lula politically. He reversed his earlier stance, changing from 'postponement' to 'cancellation' after backlash, and claimed the 2025 tariff boosted Lula’s poll numbers. Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro now hope Trump will temporarily suspend the measure to avoid electoral damage.

item.title: Lindbergh pede investigação sobre elo entre Dark Horse e PCC
item.description: Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) asked the Supreme Court to investigate the link between Entre Investimentos — which funded the 'Dark Horse' film about Jair Bolsonaro — and ACX ITC Tecnologia, a firm tied to the PCC used for money laundering, after Operation Saturno identified a R$26 million transfer. He also requested that Coaf, the Central Bank, the Federal Revenue, and the PF gather financial data from involved entities, including Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, and Eduardo Bolsonaro’s allies, to attach to Operation Compliance Zero.

item.title: A crítica de Nikolas ao vídeo de Michelle Bolsonaro contra Flávio
item.description: Nikolas Ferreira denied his involvement in Michelle Bolsonaro's video against Flávio Bolsonaro and, in private conversations with allies, criticized the style of the recording, calling it inadequate or ineffective. The report states he went beyond mere denial, expressing discomfort with the approach used. The content is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Governo usa bancos públicos para driblar resistência de instituições privadas à vitrine eleitoral de Lula
item.description: The Lula government launched the Desenrola Adimplentes program, which renegotiates debts of self-employed individuals who are current on payments, only after consulting public banks due to concerns about private institution resistance. The initiative is seen as an electoral strategy to improve the president's image among the program's target audience. The measure was announced only after confirmation of interest from state-owned banks.

item.title: Sem Michelle, quem convence a Tatiana?
item.description: The absence of Michelle Bolsonaro as a unifying figure for the right-wing female electorate puts Flávio Bolsonaro at a disadvantage, as she was uniquely able to soften the aggressive image of the campaign and mobilize activists who converted undecided women. Without her, Bolsonarist supporters must first explain internal rifts before discussing policies, weakening their ability to persuade voters like Tatiana, who prioritize respect and practical solutions for daily life. The crisis is not merely familial but structural: the bridge between the militant base and moderate female voters has been broken.

item.title: Zema e Renan Santos travam embate por voto 'antissistema'
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Novo party's pre-candidate, criticized Renan Santos of Missão for lacking political experience, calling him a 'rotating machine gun' and accusing him of making exaggerated promises. Zema aims to position himself as the true outsider of the right but sees Santos as a threat due to his rising poll numbers, despite margins of error. He also defended amnesty for Jair Bolsonaro and suggested a retrial with more impartial judges.

item.title: Defesa do Pix, momento político e corrupção: os temas citados por Flávio nos EUA para conter danos à campanha
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attended a USTR hearing in the U.S. to oppose a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian products, aiming to mitigate damage to the PL’s 2026 presidential pre-campaign. He described the electoral moment as the 'worst possible' for such a policy amid growing campaign strain. The move sought to counter negative impacts of U.S. trade policy on the Bolsonarist campaign’s image.

item.title: Candidatura de Cunha em MG é "problemaço", diz irmão de Cleitinho
item.description: Eduardo Azevedo (PL), brother of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos), labeled Eduardo Cunha's (Republicanos) pre-candidacy for federal deputy in Minas Gerais as a 'big problem' due to Cunha's corruption and money laundering convictions from Operation Car Wash. Although one conviction was annulled by the STF in 2023, Cleitinho's allies fear Cunha's tainted reputation could harm the Republican ticket in the state, where Cleitinho is running for governor. Cunha previously ran in São Paulo in 2022 and served four terms in Rio de Janeiro before seeking a return to Congress via Minas Gerais.

item.title: "Ele quer", diz irmão de Cleitinho sobre candidatura ao governo de MG
item.description: Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) wants to run for governor of Minas Gerais in 2026, according to his brother, state deputy Eduardo Azevedo (PL), who said the decision has already been made internally but depends on party negotiations. The PL in Minas Gerais, with its convention set for July 25, is pressuring for a swift announcement amid internal disagreements over supporting Cleitinho due to controversies involving Flávio Bolsonaro and the 'Dark Horse' film. While some in the PL advocate an alternative candidacy led by Vittorio Medioli, Cleitinho continues campaigning without an official declaration.

item.title: Campanha de Lula abandona IA por ordem do presidente
item.description: Lula’s campaign has decided to avoid using artificial intelligence in producing social media content and electoral materials, following a direct order from the president, who is critical of the technology and concerned about legal risks. The move also aims to prevent issues with the Electoral Justice, aligning with new TSE rules that restrict AI use in the 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting. Lula previously stated that citizens with ethical formation should not rely on AI for campaigns, as it can favor lies.

item.title: Ministro de Lula ganha aval para integrar conselho de estatal no Ceará
item.description: Education Minister Leonardo Barchini received approval from the Public Ethics Commission to join the fiscal council of Cagece while remaining in office, provided he adheres to restrictions such as not using privileged information or representing the company before the MEC. The rapporteur determined there is no conflict of interest, as his duties at the sanitation company are not directly related to the MEC's responsibilities.

item.title: Os acenos dos emissários de Lula ao mercado
item.description: Lula is leveraging missteps in Flávio Bolsonaro’s pre-campaign and the World Cup window to improve his image among financial markets, which have long rejected the PT leader. The strategy emphasizes fiscal responsibility and dialogue with productive sectors, aiming to overcome one of his core electoral weaknesses as an incumbent.

item.title: Ouvidorias fortalecem diálogo entre Justiça Eleitoral e sociedade, afirma presidente do TSE
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, president of the TSE, emphasized that the Electoral Justice's ombudsmen are pillars for strengthening democracy, acting as permanent channels of dialogue with society and transforming citizen demands into improvements in public services. He stressed that listening to the population in a qualified manner is essential to increase trust in democratic institutions and reaffirmed the Electoral Justice's commitment to placing the citizen at the center of its actions.

item.title: TSE lança ferramenta para análise da participação do eleitorado brasileiro no exterior
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched the Electoral Panel for Overseas Voters, a tool that consolidates historical microdata on the profile, geographic distribution, and participation of Brazilians eligible to vote abroad. The platform aims to support electoral logistics planning and improve public access to data previously requiring complex spreadsheets, focusing on turnout and abstention rates across global polling stations. The 2026 electoral roll data will be released by the end of July.

item.title: TSE lança nova versão da ferramenta de pesquisa de jurisprudência eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) launched an improved version of its electoral jurisprudence research tool, featuring a more intuitive interface, multi-device responsiveness, and faster, more accurate results. The update aims to enhance accessibility and efficiency for lawyers, researchers, judges, and the public, reinforcing the TSE’s commitment to digital modernization and access to electoral legal knowledge.

item.title: Infraestrutura de Tecnologia da Informação do TSE passa por atualização na segunda-feira (6)
item.description: The TSE will carry out IT infrastructure updates from next Monday (6) to Friday (10) to maintain the Candidacy System database for the 2026 elections candidate registration, which begins on July 20. During this period, the Candidaturas, Cand2, Bem na Foto, DivulgaCandContas, and CANDex Web systems will be unavailable, preventing judgment updates and reprocessing of election tallies for which ARCs have not yet been received by Sistot.

item.title: Defeso eleitoral impõe limites a agentes públicos a três meses das Eleições 2026
item.description: Starting August 4, the electoral blackout period begins, prohibiting public officials from conducting institutional publicity, personnel actions, and fund transfers until October 25 to ensure equal opportunities among candidates in the 2026 General Elections. The rules apply to federal and state public servants, direct and indirect, under Law No. 9,504/1997 and TSE Resolution No. 23,735/2024.

item.title: Clica e Confirma destaca balanço do 1º semestre no TSE e início do período de condutas vedadas
item.description: The Clica e Confirma program highlighted the TSE’s first-half 2026 performance, with 88 judgment sessions and 1,656 cases ruled on, alongside the start of the prohibited conduct period on July 4, imposing restrictions on public officials and pre-candidates to ensure electoral equality. The episode also covered a technical alignment meeting between TSE and regional electoral courts (TREs) to strengthen election security and urn functionality.

item.title: TSE realiza audiência técnica sobre divulgação de resultados das Eleições 2026
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will hold a virtual technical hearing on Monday (6) at 3 p.m. to align procedures with media outlets and institutions interested in disseminating the official results of the 2026 General Elections. The meeting will cover the official results distribution model, technological standards adopted by the TSE, information security requirements, and technical guidelines for accessing Electoral Justice services, aiming to ensure transparency and standardization in result dissemination.

item.title: À espera do tarifaço: as consequências econômicas para Brasil e EUA - O Assunto #1756
item.description: The U.S. Trade Office held public hearings on proposed tariffs against Brazilian exports, featuring input from multinational corporations and pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, who called for cancellation of the measure. Economist Daniel Sousa analyzed the economic consequences, emphasizing Brazil's role in global supply chains and the potential impact on U.S. inflation. A final decision is expected by July 15.

item.title: Tarifaço: Caiado diz que Flávio "conspirou" contra economia do Brasil
item.description: Former Goiás governor Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) of 'conspiring against Brazil's economy' for his role in discussions regarding the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian goods, calling his actions unacceptable and ideologically driven. Caiado also criticized the Itamaraty for abandoning technical diplomacy in favor of ideological foreign policy, claiming it harmed diplomatic relations with the United States.
